about: Custom types P4: monster voices go by type name. A mod ships clips for 'howler' (harness_type_voice, copied from the local moan_mod; skipped without it) and none for 'wolf' (harness_type_a). Howler's species key is its name and its pool has clips, wolf's key is its name and its pool is empty (silent). A raid of only howlers picks a howler line, a raid of wolves picks none, a mixed raid never picks wolf. A nest with both types on screen runs 600 frames of ambience in balanced mode without a code error. A voice by_mon_type naming howler resolves; the undeclared 'ghost' key is only a warning.
